# planner-executor

> Planner-executor agent pattern over a text-only LLM port: a validated JSON plan of tool steps, step references, bounded replanning after failures and content-free events Python package `trysac-planner-executor`, import name `planner_executor`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
